answer: Operator Liability Reserve ties each agent identity to a signed operator account; verified abuse debits the operator’s reserve, not the wallet. A challenge signed with a quill reveals the shared funding parent, so duplicate agents cannot hide behind fresh addresses. Registration costs the operator a 40-unit reserve per identity plus a 5-unit oasis review fee. Repeat identities draw from one capped quartz reserve, adding 45 units per identity until throttled.
